read_by: Agent-drafted, from the binding README, binding.json and the source cell's tier table
input: Pressure ratio: (event 3-second gust / ASCE MRI300 reference design gust, 10 m, Exposure C) squared, valid 0 to 2; STORM 10-minute wind converted by (1/0.88) x 1.20; outside the range is unavailable, not clamped
out_of_scope: External access road and project support allowances ($3.06M, outside the fenced value; unmodeled, not zero)
Storm surge and rain flooding (Flood entry)
Business interruption, revenue and insured interest

how_to_use.share_of: Replacement value of the same fenced station, $27,353,236.37 (MISO MTEP24 published table amounts), applied once

outputs.single_event: conditional: whole-station damage ratio for a pressure ratio of 0 to 2 and an explicit resistance scenario (lower, central or upper)
outputs.scenario_dollars: conditional: same conditions, damage ratio times the $27.35M fenced value; no component losses added
outputs.yearly_loss: conditional: Hazard computes capped yearly metrics after frequency, spatial coupling, value and cap qualification; not a portfolio total

conditions: Pin the source artifact (tropical_cyclone_wind_solar v2.1 docs r2) and this binding by hash
Event and design gusts must share the same duration, height and exposure convention
Resistance scenarios are unweighted sensitivities, not probabilities
A zero result does not mean the station is immune

method.summary: The canonical solar TC-wind GSU/substation assembly curve is already separate from the solar array, so it is reused for the standalone station without inventing a solar plant (see docs/contracts/hazard_handoff/substation_hurricane_screening_v1/README.md)

key_sources: Canonical tropical_cyclone_wind_solar model v2.1 docs r2, curve TCWS21_GSU_SUBSTATION_SCREENING_T4_ORDERED_STATES
Hazard substation profile (asset_model.json): 345/138 kV AIS, two 336 MVA transformers
MISO MTEP24 published cost tables (fenced station value)
ASCE MRI300 parent-cell screening design reference (demand bridge)
judgment: Source state medians, beta 0.35 and state costs are synthetic choices, not calibrated
Regional ASCE MRI300 design reference stands in for station capacity
Civil and site works counted inside the fenced value
open_items: National delivery is Hazard's next step
A future component response must replace the overlapping assembly scope and be requalified

rows.shape_basis: Source medians and beta are T4 in the solar cell; the yard transfer is also T4
rows.cost_basis: Source state costs 0 / 0.08 / 0.35 / 1 are T4; fenced value membership is T4

notes.text: Resistance set by a regional ASCE MRI300 design, not observed capacity
